copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想系统提升 Python 工程能力而非只复制代码
copy.tagline_en: Learn Python development principles and best practices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to systematically improve Python engineering skills beyond copying code

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 Python 开发的最佳决策原则来指导你，包括框架选择、异步与同步选择、类型提示策略、项目结构等。它教你如何思考，而不是直接复制代码。
howto.when: 当你询问 Python 项目开发相关的问题，比如选择框架、决定异步还是同步、设计项目结构时，Claude 会使用这些原则来回答。

say.text: 帮我选一个 Python Web 框架，我要做一个 API 服务。
这个任务应该用异步还是同步？
say.note: Claude 会分析你的场景，给出异步或同步的建议。

say.text: 我的 Python 项目结构应该怎么组织？
say.note: Claude 会根据项目规模推荐合适的目录结构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you based on best decision-making principles for Python development, including framework selection, async vs sync, type hints strategy, and project structure. It teaches thinking, not copying code.
howto.when_en: When you ask questions about Python project development, such as choosing a framework, deciding async vs sync, or designing project structure, Claude will use these principles to answer.

say_en.text: Help me choose a Python web framework for an API service.
say_en.note: Claude will recommend FastAPI, Django, or Flask based on your needs.

say_en.text: Should I use async or sync for this task?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze your scenario and give advice.

say_en.text: How should I organize my Python project structure?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend a directory structure based on project size.
